title: Composition of ordered integrations before taking adjoint transposes
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ compactifiable separated finite-type morphisms of Noetherian schemes. In the ordinary unbounded etale categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], write $F_a=Ra_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], $h=gf$, $W_h=D_fW_g\otimes W_f$, and use the integration and reassociation constructions $I_a,a_K$ of [def-pur-integration-transpose-data]. Let traces $t_f,t_g,t_h$ be supplied, and assume the canonical projections [def-pur-compact-support-projection-map] with $W_f,W_g,W_h$ are invertible on every coefficient. Let $\alpha:F_gF_f\simeq F_h$ be the specified compositor [def-sf-etale-support-compositor], and assume $t_h\alpha_{W_h}=t_gF_g(I_f(W_g))$. Then for every $K\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $I_h(K)\alpha_{D_hK\otimes W_h}=I_g(K)F_g(I_f(D_gK\otimes W_g)F_f(a_K))$. No exceptional right adjoints are used.

proof.text: Use the proved source-library projectionMapOfCompactification_assoc and leftDerivedUpperStar_map_braiding_hom_δ. Naturality and the braid hexagons convert the ordinary right-factor law to the coefficient-first convention. Transport along the natural exact-to-derived pullback isomorphism; its inverse cancels and its tensor comparison becomes pullTensorIso. Invert the resulting equality by cancelling the two projections and the associator. Right-unitor naturality gives integration_tensor_law.

proof.text: Apply this tensor law at D_gK and W_g. Naturality of the g projection in its sheaf argument, applied to beta=I_f(W_g), moves the tensor of beta through its inverse. Use the inverse composition equation [lem-amb-shriek-tensor-composition] and naturality of alpha to combine the two inverse projections. The pullback compositor cancels its inverse. The remaining tensor of alpha inverse followed by F_g(beta) and t_g is the tensor of t_h by the trace hypothesis. This is the displayed integration equality.
